_about: APA 7 references for every source and class reading on the site. *text* marks italics. type: primary = the original study, data, law, opinion, statement or class reading; secondary = an article reporting on someone else's work. Sorted alphabetically at build time. tests/bibliography.test.js fails if a URL used anywhere in /data is missing here. 'pending' marks details not yet confirmed.
